global.description: Global values to be accessed by all (sub)charts.

nameOverride.description: Overrides chart name used for resource names and app.kubernetes.io/name.

image.description: operators-guard container image without a tag (the tag is the chart appVersion).

historyKeep.description: Number of report-only history entries kept in the pod cache (default 24; 0 disables).

policy.description: Readiness policy passed to the engine unchanged. Only strategy is validated here.

minVersions.description: Package -> minimum installed version (major.minor.patch); below it = BELOW-MIN.

maxDaysBehind.description: A newer version in the channel for longer than this = BEHIND (default 90).

supportWarnDays.description: Vendor support ends within this many days = SUPPORT-ENDING (default 180).

defaultOwner.description: Owner for packages without a mapping or exception (default: unassigned).

repository.description: Optional OCI repository in hub Quay for the snapshot; empty = no push.

pushSecret.description: Existing dockerconfigjson Secret with Quay push credentials; required when repository is set.

instanceName.description: Value of the dashboards label on the Grafana instance.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of existing dockerconfigjson Secrets used to pull the image.

apc-global-overrides.description: Values of the apc-global-overrides library dependency.
